title: Coherent first-page lifts on prescribed CE resolutions
statement: For every scheme X and bounded-below complex K of abelian etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves], prescribe an augmented CE bicomplex I(X,K),a(X,K) [def-sp-double-complex-total], bounded below in complex degree, with injective terms and horizontal cycle, boundary and homology terms, and quasi-isomorphic augmentations on all four column families [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Then simultaneously construct presentations D(X,K) [def-weil-pbc-termwise-hypercohomology-presentation] with D(X,K).I=I(X,K), actual quotient-page realizations e [lem-weil-pbc-ce-stationary-page-naturality] and sequence maps M for each inverse-image complex map v [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Their first-page maps are cohomologyMap followed by Sheaf.H.map(v.f q) [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback]. Each such v admits a strict augmented sheaf-total lift u whose conjugated sections map [lem-weil-pbc-ce-total-sections-comparison] preserves every filtration step and induces M on cycle representatives. No CE resolution existence or support-at-every-input-bound conclusion is asserted.

proof.text: Starting from the prescribed augmented bicomplexes, construct the sections-total filtration and actual quotient pages with differentials and successor homology isomorphisms fixed on representatives. Use common finite crops to identify overlapping choices. Adjoin the graded page zero and take the signed canonical row identifications. The natural comparison with ordinary sheaf H and the K-injective total comparison fill the other fields of D without changing its I field.

For every inverse-image map apply augmented CE comparison to the prescribed source and target resolutions, then extend, flip and totalize its bicomplex map. The summand augmentation identities give the strict square. The finite-diagonal sections comparison shows that its conjugated sections map preserves complex degree and hence restricts to every filtration step.

Descend the maps on graded cycles through boundary cokernels. The chain-map equation gives compatibility with representative differentials, and the fixed successor-page comparisons make these maps a sequence morphism M. On page one the augmented row comparison computes cohomologyMap followed by Sheaf.H.map, and the equal source and target signs cancel. Zero rows and empty diagonals use the same universal properties.

theorem exists_etaleCE_coherent_prescribed_resolutions
    (I : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})),
      HomologicalComplex₂ (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
    (a : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})),
      ((CochainComplex.single₀
        (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).mapHomologicalComplex
         (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K.obj ⟶ I X K)
    (hbelow : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})),
      ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ s : ℤ, s < b → IsZero ((I X K).X s))
    (hrows : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
      (s : ℤ), QuasiIso ((a X K).f s))
    (hterms : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
      (s : ℤ) (r : ℕ), Injective (((I X K).X s).X r))
    (hhorizontal : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
      (s : ℤ) (r : ℕ),
      Injective (((I X K).cycles s).X r) ∧
      Injective ((image ((I X K).d (s - 1) s)).X r) ∧
      Injective (((I X K).homology s).X r))
    (hquasi : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
      (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})) (s : ℤ),
      QuasiIso (HomologicalComplex.cyclesMap (a X K) s) ∧
      QuasiIso (image.map (Arrow.homMk' ((a X K).f (s - 1)) ((a X K).f s)
        ((a X K).comm (s - 1) s))) ∧
      QuasiIso (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (a X K) s)):
    ∃ (D : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})),
        EtaleTermwiseHypercohomology X K)
      (M : ∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
        (L : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
        (v : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K.obj ⟶ L.obj),
        (D X K).sequence ⟶ (D Y L).sequence)
      (e : ∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})),
        EtaleCEQuotientRealization (D X K)),
      (∀ (X : Scheme.{u})
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})),
        (D X K).I = I X K) ∧
      (∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
        (L : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
        (v : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K.obj ⟶ L.obj) (p : ℕ) (q : ℤ),
        ((M f K L v).hom 1).f (q, (p : ℤ)) ≫ ((D Y L).firstPageIso p q).hom =
          ((D X K).firstPageIso p q).hom ≫
            AddCommGrpCat.ofHom ((Sheaf.H.map (v.f q) p).comp
              (cohomologyMap f (K.obj.X q) p))) ∧
      (∀ {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : Y ⟶ X)
        (K : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
        (L : CochainComplex.Plus (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))
        (v : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K.obj ⟶ L.obj),
        ∃ u : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj (D X K).sheafTotal ⟶ (D Y L).sheafTotal,
          ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} f).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).map (D X K).aug ≫ u = v ≫ (D Y L).aug ∧
          let b := (D X K).totalSectionsIso.hom ≫ ceSectionsLift f u ≫
            (D Y L).totalSectionsIso.inv
          (∀ q : ℤ, ∃ s : ((D X K).L.step q : CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ℤ) ⟶
              ((D Y L).L.step q : CochainComplex AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} ℤ),
            s ≫ ((D Y L).L.step q).arrow = ((D X K).L.step q).arrow ≫ b) ∧
          EtaleCEPageMapOnRepresentatives (D X K) (D Y L) (e X K) (e Y L)
            b (M f K L v))
